unit: One private replay of the real PostToolUse path per PR, at most eight files per invocation, warm isolated daemon. Interleaved provider/variant order per PR. Times in wall seconds, nearest-rank percentiles include failures. No feedback posted; fix rate unobservable.
reference: 52 frozen model-graded file/rule positives. The grader belongs to the OpenAI comparator model family. Counts include incomplete attempts. A separate TypeScript parser checks two syntax rules.

spend.note: PR totals use returned usage. Curated experiments and unanswered requests lack complete spend telemetry.

decision.applied: Only enable medium advisory for ts-no-magic-numbers at 0.70 for returned model jev-1.14.0. High stays 0.80. Same provider inputs and billable work. Live tail non-regression remains inconclusive.
decision.recall3trial: Curated holdout introduced a false positive.
decision.recall4trial: Global cutoff introduced a false positive for OpenAI with no curated holdout recall gain.
decision.fast1/fast2/fast-host/openai-check: Rejected gates: 27 fewer questions, no omitted reference positives, but higher p95 in both fully completed TypeSafe pairs.
labelAudit: Ky #835 simulated latency inside a fake fetch is explicitly excluded from the fixed-sleep rule.
Ky #845 checks an actual result with t.is.
Ky #826 asserts elapsed time, not a wall-clock date.
Frozen labels retained to preserve comparability.
decision.deadline: Apply a caller-side deadline around TypeSafe fetch and body reads. A stalled 400 ms control test ran past 5 seconds; the repaired test returned in approximately 402 ms. Hook retries default to zero.
decision.scoringOnlyRounds: confirm1/confirm2 and pooledSelected compare the calibration alone.

finalPaired.design: Three consecutive, interleaved old-default versus final-default rounds with separately seeded PR order. One cluster per PR across all three repeats, 5000 paired percentile bootstrap draws. Both arms use warm daemons and identical instrumentation. The earlier deadline-confirm experiment compares the cutoff-only and cutoff-plus-deadline versions.
